placements.why: The envelope's content is an architectural contract decision — how remember dispatches async jobs, returns receipts, and polls for results. No existing strata category covers this; Architecture is the organizational home for ratified system-design contracts.
placements.title: from synchronous assumption to ratified async contract
placements.frame: what architectural contracts has the org ratified to govern how its systems dispatch and retrieve work?

placements.title: remember as immediate-return async dispatch with cursor-polled extraction
placements.frame: how is the remember operation's async contract — immediate receipt, non-blocking dispatch, cursor-polled extraction — crystallized as ratified operational maxims?
placements.why: src-1 ratifies the contract's two halves (receipt in seconds, extraction watched by polling a cursor); src-2 states its guarantees as matched negations (no blocking call, no lost work); src-3 reframes the same contract as a key decision (dispatch, then poll or piggyback); src-4 renders Wynn's ratification in reported speech. All four carry the same thematic content: the async remember contract as ratified operational maxims in pipeline vocabulary — a subject future envelopes will keep feeding.
